caseTitle.en: A day of following the channels

condition.zh: 經絡 · 循行與遠端主治

title.en: Where a channel runs, it treats

tagline.zh: 一個落枕、一顆牙痛，和一個說是胃痛的阿伯
tagline.en: A stiff neck, a toothache, and an old man who says it is his stomach

desc.zh: 在推拿室學循經取穴：先畫經，再找穴，再問一句「確定是這裡的病嗎」。
desc.en: Learning channel-based point selection in the tuina room: draw the channel, find the point, then ask “are we sure the problem is here?”

desc.zh: 點按、揉、滾，手是你的工具。今天你學的是：什麼時候手要停下來。
desc.en: Pressing, kneading, rolling: your hands are the tools. Today you learn when the hands must stop.

about.zh: 上課從不帶掛圖，直接用水性筆在學生手臂上畫經絡。口頭禪：「寧失其穴，勿失其經。」
about.en: Never brings a chart to class; draws the channels on students’ arms in washable pen. Catchphrase: “Better to miss the point than the channel.”

about.zh: 一米八五的推拿師，手勁大、心很細。會用台語唱四總穴歌。今天牙痛。
about.en: A towering therapist with strong hands and a gentle heart. Sings the Four Command Points song in Taiwanese. Has toothache today.

role.zh: 二十七歲，早上起床落枕
role.en: Twenty-seven, woke with a stiff neck

about.zh: 虛構教學個案。工程師，昨晚在沙發上睡著，今天頭轉不過來，只能整個身體一起轉。
about.en: Fictional teaching case. An engineer who fell asleep on the sofa; today she cannot turn her head, only her whole body.

about.zh: 虛構教學個案。退休公車司機，糖尿病、高血壓、抽菸幾十年。每個月來推拿肩膀。今天爬樓梯上來，說胃又痛了。
about.en: Fictional teaching case. Retired bus driver with diabetes, high blood pressure and decades of smoking. Comes monthly for his shoulders. Today he climbed the stairs and says his stomach hurts again.

about.zh: 包包裡永遠有一包蘇打餅乾和黃伯的藥袋。
about.en: Always carries a packet of crackers and her husband’s medicine bag.

about.zh: 會回電，也會告訴你哪一個細節最有用。
about.en: Calls back, and tells you which detail helped most.

term.en: where a channel runs, it treats

plain.zh: 中醫取穴原則：經絡循行經過的部位，該經的穴位可以治療那裡的病。
plain.en: A TCM principle of point choice: the points of a channel can treat the places that channel passes through.

plain.zh: 先判斷病在哪一條經，再沿著那條經選穴，常常選離病處很遠的穴。
plain.en: Decide which channel the problem lies on, then choose points along it, often far from the problem itself.

plain.zh: 在手腳肘膝以下選穴治療頭面軀幹的病；例如落枕取手上的後溪。
plain.en: Using points below the elbows and knees to treat the head and trunk; for a stiff neck, Houxi on the hand.

plain.zh: 「肚腹三里留，腰背委中求，頭項尋列缺，面口合谷收。」四句記住四個遠端要穴。
plain.en: “Belly: keep Zusanli; back: seek Weizhong; head and neck: find Lieque; face and mouth: Hegu gathers.” Four lines, four great distal points.

plain.zh: 肺、心包、心三經，從胸走手，走在手臂內側。
plain.en: The lung, pericardium and heart channels: from the chest to the hand along the inner arm.

plain.zh: 胃、膽、膀胱三經，從頭走足，走在腿的前、側、後面。
plain.en: The stomach, gallbladder and bladder channels: from the head to the feet down the front, side and back of the leg.

plain.zh: 睡姿不良或受寒後頸部肌肉痙攣，頭轉不過去；多數幾天內緩解。
plain.en: Neck muscle spasm after a bad sleeping position or a chill, so the head will not turn; usually settles within days.

plain.zh: 在遠端穴位點按或留針時，請病人慢慢活動患處；常用於落枕、扭傷。
plain.en: While a distal point is pressed or needled, the patient gently moves the painful part; used for stiff necks and sprains.

plain.zh: 推拿手法：用指端在穴位上持續、穩定地按壓，力道以病人能耐受為度。
plain.en: A tuina technique: steady pressure on a point with a fingertip, as firm as the patient can tolerate.

plain.zh: 內臟的痛被大腦當成來自別處，例如心臟的痛跑到上腹、下巴或左手臂。
plain.en: Pain from an organ felt somewhere else, such as heart pain felt in the upper belly, jaw or left arm.

plain.zh: 供應心臟下壁的血管阻塞；常以上腹痛、噁心、冷汗表現，可能合併心跳過慢。
plain.en: Blockage of the artery feeding the underside of the heart; often shows as upper-belly pain, nausea and cold sweat, sometimes with a slow heartbeat.

plain.zh: 一呼一吸之間跳得少於正常的脈；中醫認為主寒，但現代要想到心臟傳導問題。
plain.en: A pulse with fewer beats per breath than normal; TCM reads cold, but today it also raises heart-conduction problems.

plain.zh: 皮膚濕冷的汗；伴胸痛、上腹痛或頭暈時，是身體在發出警報。
plain.en: Clammy sweat; with chest pain, upper-belly pain or dizziness, it is the body raising an alarm.

name.zh: 白板上的十二經走向圖
name.en: The twelve-channel map on the board

text.zh: 江醫師畫的一個大圈：胸走手、手走頭、頭走足、足走胸，周而復始。圈外寫了一行小字：「每一條經都有兩端，病人站在其中一端。」
text.en: Dr Chiang’s big circle: chest to hand, hand to head, head to foot, foot to chest, round and round. Outside it, small writing: “Every channel has two ends, and the patient is standing at one of them.”

text.zh: 推拿室角落的軟墊，學生在這裡互相循經點穴。地上貼著格線，方便看姿勢與動作範圍。
text.en: Soft mats in the corner of the tuina room where students trace channels on each other. Tape lines on the floor show posture and range of movement.

text.zh: 慢性頸部問題在評估後才使用。急性落枕、外傷後、手麻無力未釐清前，都不上牽引。
text.en: Used for chronic neck problems after assessment. Not for an acute stiff neck, after injury, or with unexplained arm numbness or weakness.

name.en: The channel drawn on your arm

text.zh: 江醫師用水性筆在你左前臂畫的手陽明大腸經：從食指尖、合谷、曲池一路到肩。洗澡前你拍了一張照片。
text.en: The hand yangming large-intestine channel, drawn by Dr Chiang on your left forearm in washable pen: index fingertip, Hegu, Quchi, up to the shoulder. You took a photo before your shower.

text.zh: 手三陰（肺、心包、心）從胸走手，在手指交手三陽；手三陽（大腸、三焦、小腸）從手走頭，在頭面交足三陽；足三陽（胃、膽、膀胱）從頭走足，在腳趾交足三陰；足三陰（脾、肝、腎）從足走腹胸，回到手三陰。流注順序：肺、大腸、胃、脾、心、小腸、膀胱、腎、心包、三焦、膽、肝。手陽明大腸經在人中左右交叉，到對側鼻旁。
text.en: The three hand yin (lung, pericardium, heart) run chest to hand and hand over to the three hand yang at the fingers; the hand yang (large intestine, triple burner, small intestine) run hand to head and hand over to the foot yang on the face; the foot yang (stomach, gallbladder, bladder) run head to foot and hand over to the foot yin at the toes; the foot yin (spleen, liver, kidney) run foot to belly and chest, back to the hand yin. The flow order: lung, large intestine, stomach, spleen, heart, small intestine, bladder, kidney, pericardium, triple burner, gallbladder, liver. The large-intestine channel crosses at the philtrum to the opposite side of the nose.

name.zh: 四總穴與遠端取穴的道理與界線
name.en: Command points: the logic and the limits

text.zh: 中醫認為經絡把遠端與近端連成一線，所以足三里治腹、委中治腰背、列缺治頭項、合谷治面口。遠端取穴的好處是不碰疼痛處，還能邊按邊活動。界線：它治的是「已經確定」的腹痛、腰背痛、頭項痛、牙痛，不是用來跳過診斷。胃痛要先確定是胃，牙痛要先確定只是牙。
text.en: TCM holds that the channels link far and near, so Zusanli treats the belly, Weizhong the back, Lieque the head and neck, Hegu the face and mouth. Distal points spare the painful area and let the patient move while you press. The limit: they treat belly, back, neck and tooth pain that has already been diagnosed; they are not a way round diagnosis. Make sure a stomach ache is the stomach, and a toothache only a tooth.

name.en: Referred pain and the “stomach ache” red flag

text.zh: 心臟與上腹的感覺神經進入相同的脊髓節段，所以心臟的痛可能被感覺成胃痛、下巴痛或左手痛。下壁心肌梗塞常以上腹痛、噁心、冷汗表現，還可能心跳過慢。糖尿病人、女性、長者更常不典型。紅旗：用力或爬樓梯誘發、冷汗、喘、噁心、臉色發灰、心跳過慢或不規則：停下手、叫救護車。
text.en: The heart and the upper belly send their sensory nerves into the same spinal segments, so heart pain can be felt as stomach, jaw or left-arm pain. An inferior heart attack often shows as upper-belly pain, nausea and cold sweat, sometimes with a slow heartbeat. Diabetics, women and older people are more often atypical. Red flags: brought on by effort or stairs, cold sweat, breathlessness, nausea, grey colour, a slow or irregular pulse. Stop your hands and call an ambulance.

name.en: Stiff neck: care and red flags

text.zh: 典型落枕：睡醒後單側頸痛、轉頭受限，沒有外傷、沒有手麻無力。中醫常先取遠端穴（後溪、落枕穴、列缺）配合動氣法，再溫和放鬆局部肌肉。急性期不做頸椎牽引、不做大力扳法。紅旗：外傷後、手麻無力、發燒合併頸僵、劇烈頭痛、夜間痛醒、體重減輕：先轉診。
text.en: A typical stiff neck: one-sided neck pain on waking with limited turning, no injury, no arm numbness or weakness. TCM often starts with distal points (Houxi, the stiff-neck point, Lieque) with move-while-pressing, then gentle local muscle work. No traction and no forceful manipulation in the acute stage. Red flags: after injury, arm numbness or weakness, fever with neck stiffness, severe headache, pain that wakes at night, weight loss: refer first.

guide.en: Watch Dr Chiang draw the channels

lines.zh: 推拿室早上八點半。江醫師在白板上畫了一個大圈，然後轉身抓起你的左手臂。
lines.en: Half past eight in the tuina room. Dr Chiang draws a big circle on the board, then turns and takes your left arm.

lines.zh: 寧失其穴，勿失其經。穴找偏一點還有效，經找錯就全錯。先排走向。
lines.en: Better to miss the point than the channel. A point slightly off still works; the wrong channel is all wrong. First, the directions.

lines.zh: 循經取穴，先要知道經往哪裡走。
lines.en: Choosing points along the channel starts with knowing which way it runs.

steps.en: Foot yin: foot to belly and chest

post.zh: 一個圈，周而復始。手三陰走手臂內側，足三陽走腿的前、側、後面。
post.en: One circle, round and round. The three hand yin channels run along the inner arm; the three foot yang channels down the front, side and back of the leg.

guide.en: Trace a channel on Big Bear's arm

lines.zh: 手陽明大腸經，從食指走到臉。在大熊手臂上走一次。
lines.en: The hand yangming large-intestine channel, index finger to face. Walk it on Big Bear’s arm.

lines.zh: 我手毛很多，你小心。
lines.en: My arms are hairy. Go carefully.

post.zh: 到了人中，左之右、右之左，交叉到對側鼻旁的迎香。古書寫得清清楚楚。
post.en: At the philtrum it crosses: left to right, right to left, ending at Yingxiang beside the opposite nostril. The classics say so plainly.

post.zh: 這一條，我畫在你手上，今天別洗掉。
post.en: I’ve drawn this one on your arm. Don’t wash it off today.

name.en: A head that will not turn

note.zh: 小雯：落枕，遠端取穴加動氣法

lines.zh: 昨晚在沙發睡著，今天頭轉不過去，只能整個人一起轉。
lines.en: Fell asleep on the sofa. Now I can’t turn my head; I turn my whole body.

lines.zh: 有沒有撞到？手會麻、會沒力嗎？有發燒嗎？
lines.en: Any knock? Numb or weak arms? Fever?

lines.zh: 都沒有。就是脖子左邊像打了一個結。
lines.en: None of that. Just a knot on the left side of my neck.

lines.zh: 紅旗問完了，好。落枕。頭項尋列缺，還有呢？
lines.en: Red flags asked; good. A stiff neck. For head and neck, Lieque. What else?

q.en: Point to Houxi, the stiff-neck point and Lieque

post.zh: 後溪是小腸經，通督脈；小腸經走過頸側和肩胛。落枕穴在手背二、三掌骨之間。
post.en: Houxi is on the small-intestine channel and links to the Governor vessel; that channel crosses the side of the neck and the shoulder blade. The stiff-neck point is between the second and third knuckles on the back of the hand.

post.zh: 大熊點按，小雯慢慢轉頭。這叫動氣法。
post.en: Big Bear does the point pressing, Hsiao-Wen turns her head slowly. That’s move-while-pressing.

post.zh: 欸？好像可以轉多一點點了。
post.en: Hey, I can turn a little further.

lines.zh: 旁邊那台可以拉一拉嗎？我同事說拉完就好。
lines.en: Can that machine stretch me? My colleague says it fixed her.

q.zh: 急性落枕，無外傷、無手麻。下一步？
q.en: Acute stiff neck, no injury, no numbness. Next?

options.zh: 不牽引、不扳，遠端點按加溫和放鬆
options.en: No traction or manipulation; distal pressing, gentle work

why.zh: 急性落枕是肌肉痙攣，牽引與大力扳法可能讓它更緊甚至受傷。遠端取穴、動氣法，再溫和放鬆局部，加上熱敷。
why.en: An acute stiff neck is muscle spasm; traction or a forceful thrust can tighten it further or injure it. Distal points, move-while-pressing, then gentle local work and warmth.

options.en: Put her on the traction couch

why.zh: 牽引用在評估過的慢性頸部問題，不是急性肌肉痙攣。
why.en: Traction is for assessed chronic neck problems, not acute spasm.

options.zh: 用力扳一下，「喀」一聲就好
options.en: One firm thrust till it clicks

why.zh: 「喀」一聲不是治療指標。急性期大力扳法有受傷風險。
why.en: A click is not a treatment target, and forceful thrusts in the acute stage risk injury.

post.zh: 牽引床今天休息。我用揉法，很輕。
post.en: The traction couch has the day off. I’ll knead, very gently.

lines.zh: 先揉斜方肌上緣，再滾法放鬆肩胛之間。力道從輕開始。
lines.en: Knead the top of the trapezius first, then roll between the shoulder blades. Start light.

lines.zh: 頸前面不按。頸動脈在那裡，我的手很大，要更小心。
lines.en: Nothing on the front of the neck. The carotid is there, and my hands are big, so extra care.

lines.zh: 你的手好暖。
lines.en: Your hands are so warm.

lines.zh: 紅外線燈也開了。今晚睡枕頭，不睡沙發。
lines.en: The infrared lamp’s on too. Tonight: pillow, not sofa.

note.zh: 面口合谷收，牙醫也要看
note.en: Hegu for the mouth; still see a dentist

lines.zh: 我自己牙痛三天了。面口合谷收，對吧？我一直按。
lines.en: My tooth’s ached for three days. Hegu gathers the face and mouth, right? I keep pressing it.

lines.zh: 合谷可以幫忙緩解。但牙齦腫、臉腫、發燒、張不開嘴，就要看牙醫。
lines.en: Hegu can help ease it. But swollen gums, a swollen face, fever, or a jaw that won’t open: dentist.

lines.zh: 我怕牙醫。
lines.en: I’m scared of dentists.

lines.zh: 你那麼高大，怕牙醫。
lines.en: Big as you are, scared of dentists.

lines.zh: 合谷繼續按，我幫你掛號。四總穴是幫忙，不是代替。
lines.en: Keep pressing Hegu; I’ll book you in. The command points help; they don’t replace.

lines.zh: 紀錄：急性落枕，紅旗皆無。後溪、落枕穴、列缺點按配合動氣法，局部輕揉與熱敷。
lines.en: Record: acute stiff neck, no red flags. Houxi, the stiff-neck point and Lieque pressed with movement; gentle local kneading and warmth.

lines.zh: 再寫：若手麻、無力、發燒、越來越痛，回診或就醫。
lines.en: Add: return or seek care if numbness, weakness, fever or worsening pain.

note.zh: 黃伯：爬樓梯後上腹痛、冷汗
note.en: Huang: belly pain after stairs, cold sweat

guide.en: Uncle Huang says his stomach hurts again

lines.zh: 他爬樓梯上來，到一半就說胃又痛了。
lines.en: He climbed the stairs and halfway up said his stomach hurt again.

lines.zh: 老毛病啦。按一下足三里就好，肚腹三里留嘛。大熊上次就是這樣按。
lines.en: Old trouble. Press Zusanli and I’m fine; “belly: keep Zusanli”. Big Bear did that last time.

lines.zh: 黃伯額頭冒著冷汗，手按在上腹，臉色灰灰的。
lines.en: Uncle Huang’s forehead is beaded with cold sweat, his hand on his upper belly, his face greyish.

lines.zh: 先別按。你看到什麼？
lines.en: Don’t press yet. What do you see?

q.zh: 六十三歲、糖尿病、抽菸，爬樓梯後上腹痛、冷汗，要你按足三里。你？
q.en: Sixty-three, diabetic, smoker; upper-belly pain after stairs, cold sweat; wants Zusanli pressed. You?

options.zh: 先停：問誘因與症狀、量脈與血壓、叫醫師
options.en: Stop: ask, check pulse and BP, call the doctor

why.zh: 用力誘發的上腹痛加冷汗，在糖尿病、抽菸的長者要先想到心肌梗塞。糖尿病人的心臟痛常不典型。
why.en: Upper-belly pain brought on by effort, with cold sweat, in an older diabetic smoker: think heart attack first. Diabetics often have atypical cardiac pain.

options.zh: 先按足三里看看會不會好
options.en: Press Zusanli and see if it eases

why.zh: 按了舒服一點也不代表安全，只會延誤。
why.en: Feeling a little better after pressing does not make it safe; it only delays.

options.en: Warm pack on the belly and rest

why.zh: 冷汗加用力誘發的痛，不是熱敷能處理的。
why.en: Cold sweat and effort-induced pain are not a job for a warm pack.

post.zh: 黃伯，痛會跑到胸口、下巴或手嗎？會喘嗎？
post.en: Mr Huang, does the pain spread to your chest, jaw or arm? Are you breathless?
A bit of pressure up to my throat. I feel sick.

lines.zh: 大熊的拇指已經放在足三里上。黃伯說「有比較好」，但冷汗沒停，臉色更灰。
lines.en: Big Bear’s thumb is already on Zusanli. Uncle Huang says “a bit better”, but the cold sweat hasn’t stopped and his face is greyer.

lines.zh: 停手。「比較好」不等於安全。
lines.en: Hands off. “A bit better” is not the same as safe.

lines.zh: 把脈。數一數，慢慢說。
lines.en: Take his pulse. Count it; then tell me slowly.

q.zh: 黃伯的脈很慢，沉而無力。配合冷汗、上腹痛。你的判斷？
q.en: Uncle Huang’s pulse is very slow, deep and weak. With cold sweat and upper-belly pain. Your judgement?

options.zh: 遲脈；配合冷汗，先當心臟急症
options.en: Slow pulse; with cold sweat, treat as cardiac

why.zh: 中醫認為遲脈主寒，但冷汗、用力誘發的上腹痛加上心跳慢，可能是下壁心肌梗塞影響心臟傳導。先當急症。
why.en: TCM reads a slow pulse as cold, but cold sweat, effort-induced upper-belly pain and a slow heart may be an inferior heart attack affecting conduction. Treat it as an emergency first.

options.en: Slow pulse: stomach cold; moxa Zhongwan

why.zh: 脈名對了，判斷錯了。胃寒不會讓人冒冷汗、臉色發灰。
why.en: Right pulse name, wrong conclusion. Stomach cold does not cause cold sweat and a grey face.

why.zh: 他的脈是慢的，不是快的。
why.en: His pulse is slow, not fast.

why.zh: 滑脈流利如珠，和他的沉弱相反。
why.en: Slippery rolls smoothly, the opposite of his deep, weak pulse.

post.zh: 經絡也好，脈也好，都在叫你停下來。
post.en: The channels and the pulse are both telling you to stop.

guide.en: Uncle Huang says he feels very dizzy

lines.zh: 血氧機上的心跳數字很低。黃伯說頭暈、想吐，手越來越冰。
lines.en: The heart rate on the oximeter is very low. Uncle Huang says he’s dizzy and sick, his hands getting colder.

options.zh: 讓他躺下、叫救護車、監測、準備 AED
options.en: Lie him down, ambulance, monitor, AED ready

why.zh: 心跳過慢合併冷汗、頭暈、上腹痛：可能是下壁心肌梗塞。躺下維持腦部血流、立即叫救護車、持續監測，AED 放在旁邊以防萬一。
why.en: Slow heart rate with cold sweat, dizziness and upper-belly pain: possibly an inferior heart attack. Lie him down for blood to the brain, call an ambulance now, keep monitoring, and have the AED beside him just in case.

options.en: Help him up for a little walk

why.zh: 走動增加心臟負擔，還可能昏倒跌傷。
why.en: Walking loads the heart and he may faint and fall.

why.zh: 這不是中暑。刮痧延誤送醫。
why.en: This is not heatstroke. Guasha delays the ambulance.

why.zh: 先叫救護車。任何處置都不能延誤送醫。
why.en: Ambulance first. Nothing should delay getting him to hospital.

post.zh: 他的藥袋在這裡。他早上還說手臂有點痠。
post.en: His medicines are here. This morning he said his arm ached a bit.

post.zh: 救護車到樓下了。我去幫忙抬。
post.en: Ambulance is downstairs. I’ll help carry.

guide.zh: 等救護車時寫轉送重點

lines.zh: 急診第一個會做什麼？為什麼胃痛要看心臟？
lines.en: What will the ED do first? And why look at the heart for a stomach ache?

question.zh: 黃伯到了急診，第一個檢查是什麼？為什麼胃痛要看心臟？
question.en: At the ED, what is Uncle Huang’s first test? Why look at the heart for a stomach ache?

answer.zh: 十二導程心電圖，到院後盡快完成，再加上抽血驗心肌酵素。心臟與上腹的感覺神經進入相同的脊髓節段，大腦分不清痛從哪裡來，這叫牽涉痛。下壁心肌梗塞常以上腹痛、噁心、冷汗表現，還可能心跳過慢。
answer.en: A twelve-lead ECG as soon as he arrives, plus blood tests for heart enzymes. The heart and upper belly share spinal segments, so the brain cannot tell where the pain comes from: referred pain. An inferior heart attack often shows as upper-belly pain, nausea and cold sweat, sometimes with a slow heart.

post.zh: 轉送單：爬樓梯誘發上腹痛、悶到喉嚨、冷汗、噁心、遲脈、頭暈。發生時間寫上。
post.en: Transfer note: upper-belly pain on stairs, pressure up to the throat, cold sweat, nausea, slow pulse, dizziness. Time of onset written down.

post.zh: 經絡講「循行」，牽涉痛講「節段」。古今都在問同一件事：痛從哪裡來。
post.en: The channels speak of pathways, referred pain of spinal segments. Old and new both ask the same thing: where does the pain come from?

note.zh: 黃伯：下壁心肌梗塞，已放支架

sub.zh: 黃伯的心導管結果出來了
sub.en: Uncle Huang's catheter result is in

lines.zh: 黃伯是下壁心肌梗塞，已經做心導管放支架。心跳現在穩了。
lines.en: Uncle Huang had an inferior heart attack; he’s had a catheter and a stent. His heart rate is stable now.

lines.zh: 你們寫的「爬樓梯誘發」和「遲脈」，我們一看就懂。
lines.en: Your “brought on by stairs” and “slow pulse” told us everything at a glance.

lines.zh: 一個脈名，寫對地方，就是救命的線索。
lines.en: A pulse name, written in the right place, becomes a life-saving clue.

guide.en: Talk with Big Bear about last month

lines.zh: 他上個月也說胃痛，我幫他按足三里，他就說好了。
lines.en: Last month he said his stomach hurt too. I pressed Zusanli and he said he was fine.

lines.zh: 那次可能真的是胃。今天不一樣：爬樓梯、冷汗、臉色、脈。
lines.en: Maybe that time it really was his stomach. Today was different: stairs, sweat, colour, pulse.

lines.zh: 以後爬樓梯上來就喊痛、還冒冷汗的，我先叫醫師，手先不動。
lines.en: From now on, anyone who climbs up in pain with a cold sweat: I call a doctor first and keep my hands still.

note.en: Better to miss the channel than the person

lines.zh: 你在黃伯面前先停下來了。四總穴歌是給已經確定的病，不是拿來跳過確定的。
lines.en: You stopped before touching Uncle Huang. The command points are for problems already diagnosed, not a way to skip the diagnosis.

lines.zh: 你剛剛差點先按足三里。肚腹三里留是真的，但「胃痛」要先確定是胃。
lines.en: You nearly pressed Zusanli first. “Belly: keep Zusanli” is true, but a stomach ache has to be the stomach first.

lines.zh: 今天三個痛：脖子、牙、胃。哪一個不在它說的地方？
lines.en: Three pains today: neck, tooth, stomach. Which one wasn’t where it said it was?

lines.zh: 胃。它其實在心臟。
lines.en: The stomach. It was really the heart.

lines.zh: 寧失其穴，勿失其經。今天再加一句：寧失其經，勿失其人。
lines.en: Better to miss the point than the channel. Today, one more: better to miss the channel than the person.

lines.zh: 你低頭看左手臂，那條水性筆畫的大腸經還在。
lines.en: You look down at your left arm; the large-intestine channel in washable pen is still there.

note.zh: 小雯能轉頭，大熊掛了牙醫

lines.zh: 頭可以轉了！今晚睡枕頭。大熊說要用台語唱四總穴歌給我聽，我拒絕了。
lines.en: I can turn my head! Pillow tonight. Big Bear offered to sing me the command-points song in Taiwanese; I declined.

lines.zh: 牙醫掛好了，明天早上。我很勇敢。
lines.en: Dentist booked, tomorrow morning. I am very brave.

lines.zh: 黃媽媽也傳來一張照片：黃伯在病房比了一個讚，旁邊是一包沒開的蘇打餅乾。
lines.en: Mrs Huang sends a photo too: Uncle Huang on the ward giving a thumbs-up, beside an unopened packet of crackers.

sub.zh: 寧失其穴，勿失其經；寧失其經，勿失其人
sub.en: Miss the point, not the channel; miss the channel, not the person
